recipes.name: EBIT and EBITDA, normalised

definition.numerator: Operating profit before finance costs and tax, excluding impairments and reversals, downstream inventory at replacement cost (IFRS) or LIFO (US GAAP), leases aligned to IFRS 16; EBITDA adds DD&A

ordered_steps: Validate generic fields and definitions.
Start from operating profit as defined (before finance costs and tax).
Add impairment losses; subtract reversals (IFRS only).
IFRS: subtract the disclosed inventory holding gain; US GAAP LIFO: subtract any LIFO liquidation gain.
US GAAP EBIT: add the disclosed interest-equivalent part of operating lease cost; EBITDA: add DD&A and the full operating lease cost.
Items that belong to another basis are rejected, not ignored.
Convert at the period-average rate.
recipes.ifrs_vs_us_gaap: IAS 36 reversal vs none under US GAAP; IAS 2 bans LIFO; IFRS 16 vs ASC 842 operating lease cost; IFRS 6 vs successful efforts/full cost.

recipes.name: Cash flow from operations, normalised to one placement policy

definition.numerator: Reported CFO moved to the uniform placement policy (see notes)

ordered_steps: Validate generic fields; classifications must be in their allow-lists and consistent with the framework.
IFRS: subtract lease principal payments; US GAAP: subtract finance lease principal payments.
If interest paid sits in financing (IFRS), subtract it.
If dividends received sit in investing (IFRS), add the disclosed amount; if they already sit in operating, the reclassification item must not be supplied (double count).
If dividends paid sit in operating (IFRS), add them back.
Interest received outside operating -> NOT_COMPARABLE (no recipe).
Convert at the period-average rate.
recipes.ifrs_vs_us_gaap: IAS 7 classification choices vs ASC 230; IFRS 16 vs ASC 842 lease cash flows.

recipes.notes: Uniform placement policy: dividends received from associates, joint ventures and other investments are placed in operating cash flow for every company; dividends paid (to parent shareholders and to NCI) and lease principal are placed in financing; interest paid in operating. definition.numerator: Net debt = borrowings + all lease liabilities - cash and cash equivalents
definition.denominator: Gearing = net debt / (net debt + total equity incl. NCI)

Cash definition must be cash and cash equivalents only.

Include all lease liabilities on both frameworks.
Gearing denominator must be positive.
Convert balances at the closing rate dated the period end.
